body: apps/desktop SidebarResizer perf rewrite (was laggy): drag now mutates aside.style.width DIRECTLY via a targetRef during pointermove (rAF-coalesced so at most one DOM write per paint), and only commits to React state + libsql on pointerup via onCommit(finalWidth) — exactly one re-render + one IPC write per gesture instead of 60/sec. Same listeners-installed-once-on-mount + setter-via-ref pattern as before (still survives parent re-renders). GENERAL RULE: any 60Hz drag in this app (resizer / tab reorder / slider preview) must use live-DOM-mutation during the drag and only commit to React/IPC on release; setState-on-every-pointermove is always too slow once the shell is non-trivial.
